posts.title: Finding bugs in DuckDB with property-based testing
posts.description: DuckDB is a widely used database and a personal favorite. I recently found some bugs in DuckDB using property-based testing and wanted to share how the bugs were found (all these bugs were reported and promptly fixed). posts.title: Finding All Solutions to LinkedIn Queens with a SAT Solver and Model Checkers
posts.description: LinkedIn Queens is a puzzle played on an n × n grid with the following rules: The grid is divided into n colored regions. Each row, column, and colored region must contain exactly one queen. No two queens may be adjacent, including diagonally. However, diagonals at a distance are allowed.
